workflow.metadata.warning.ProcessingPath: Processing destination paths conflict. Input files have been preserved.
workflow.fileRecovery.ProcessingPathConf: This step has conflicting destination paths and processing is paused.
Review the files and destinations below. Narrow the file selector or change the target names. For a frozen execution plan, use “Revise processing plan” in the task.
After revising and confirming continuation, paths will be checked using existing files and valid upstream steps.
Multiple inputs would produce the same destination path
File and directory destination paths conflict
Destination paths refer to the same location on this file system
The destination already contains a file or directory
workflow.metadata.warning.ExtractionLayo: Multiple outputs have the same path. The input files were retained.
workflow.fileRecovery.ExtractionLayoutCo: The selected layout assigns multiple files or directories to the same path.
Inspect the inputs and use an archive-named folder or give the conflicting files distinct names.
After you confirm the revised plan, the workflow continues with the existing files.
workflow.fileRecovery.MissingVolumes.why: The extraction tool reported an incomplete archive or a required volume that could not be found. This does not establish an incorrect password.
workflow.fileRecovery.MissingVolumes.act: Check the volume count and names. Add or rename parts only with clear evidence, without mixing different archives.
workflow.fileRecovery.MissingVolumes.nex: Correct the files in the current directory, then continue processing. Existing complete files do not need to be downloaded again.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveProbeTimedO: Archive format discovery exceeded its time limit. This does not mean instructions or an archive password are missing.
Check that the file storage is accessible, then retry the current step.
Continue file processing with the saved plan and valid checkpoints, without downloading or transferring again.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveProbeToolFa: The archive tool could not finish identifying the format. Extractability is still unknown.
Check the archive dependency and file access, then retry the current step.
Continue the current processing operation using completed steps and existing files.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveDetectionBu: Archive discovery reached its candidate or read budget and paused.
Inspect this step's files and narrow the selection or revise the instructions. A frozen execution plan requires a safe revision first.
Keep existing files while the scope is reviewed; scanning will not expand without bounds.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveProbeOutput: The archive tool returned more output than the safety limit allows, so the format remains unconfirmed.
Review the selected files and intended format. A frozen execution plan requires a safe revision first.
Retain files and completed steps while processing instructions are reviewed.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveProbeIncomp: The available information is insufficient to safely confirm the archive format.
Check the original instructions, files and step order. A frozen execution plan requires a safe revision first.
Remain paused until instructions are confirmed, without guessing an archive format.
workflow.fileRecovery.ProcessingInputNot: This step's selection rule does not match any input files.
Inspect this step's files and check names and selection rules. A frozen execution plan requires a safe revision first.
Keep completed upstream steps and files when revising the instructions.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveInputRequir: No supported archive could be confirmed among the selected files.
Inspect the files and original instructions. Renaming or merging may be required first; file extensions alone are not enough evidence.
Confirm the appropriate instructions before continuing. A frozen execution plan requires a safe revision first.
workflow.waitReason.ArchiveProbeUpgradeR: Archive format can be checked again
workflow.metadata.warning.ArchiveProbeUp: Archive format can be checked again
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveProbeUpgrad: An earlier version could not identify this file. The current detector can check it again; extraction is not yet guaranteed.
Confirm the files are accessible, then retry the current step.
Reuse the saved plan, files and completed steps without downloading or transferring again.
workflow.waitReason.ArchiveProbePrefixLi: Archive prefix exceeds current tool support
workflow.metadata.warning.ArchiveProbePr: Archive prefix exceeds current tool support
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveProbePrefix: An embedded ZIP was confirmed, but its media prefix exceeds the archive tool’s bounded opening limit. The source and processing instructions are not the problem.
The updated tool can recheck this embedded ZIP. Retry the current step to validate its structure and reuse existing files; downloading again is unnecessary.
Only files explicitly selected for extraction receive a bounded check. Unsupported structures remain paused for review.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveNameEncodin: The archive tool could not handle the ZIP filenames, or the selected encoding does not support this format. The original archive and existing files have been preserved.
Check the original instructions and format, then revise this step’s filename encoding.
Continue only with confirmed inputs; do not guess an encoding or download again.
workflow.waitReason.ArchivePasswordEncod: ZIP compatibility reader does not support this format
workflow.metadata.warning.ArchivePasswor: ZIP compatibility reader does not support this format
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchivePasswordEnc: The ZIP compatibility reader does not support this container structure, encryption or compression method. It supports ordinary single-volume ZIP and selected prefixed ZIP/ZIP64 structures verified within bounded checks. Split archives and other formats require their corresponding processing steps.
Check the archive format and processing steps. Specify ZIP password encoding only when needed. Keep unsupported structures pending review; safely revise a frozen plan first.
Keep the source and completed steps; do not alter the password or broaden scanning.
workflow.waitReason.ArchivePasswordNotRe: The password contains characters outside the selected encoding
workflow.metadata.warning.ArchivePasswor: The password contains characters outside the selected encoding
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchivePasswordNot: The known password cannot be fully represented in the selected byte encoding. No characters were replaced and no altered password was tried.
Check the password and its original encoding, then revise this extraction step. Do not remove characters to guess a password.
Continue with the confirmed password and encoding, reusing the existing input.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveGroupInputC: The current archive groups cannot be reliably matched to the old step records. Existing extraction results cannot be reused automatically. Files and history are preserved.
Revise the processing plan from verified downloaded or processed files, checking which archives are independent and which files belong to a multipart archive.
Save the revised plan before continuing. No new download is needed, and retrying the old step will not bypass this check.
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveIntegrityFa: Authentication, CRC, size or structural consistency checks failed. No extraction result was published.
Keep the source and check its published checksum or inspect it with a trusted tool. This is not necessarily a wrong password and does not justify blind redownloading.
Continue delivery only after integrity is confirmed or trusted manual processing is complete. This step stays paused.
workflow.waitReason.ArchiveExpansionLimi: ZIP compatibility extraction reached a safety limit
workflow.metadata.warning.ArchiveExpansi: ZIP compatibility extraction reached a safety limit
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveExpansionLi: The ZIP compatibility reader is limited to 10,000 entries, an 8 MiB catalog and 64 GiB of expanded data. This input exceeds its supported range.
Check the input and expected size, then use a trusted tool that supports it. Limits are not relaxed automatically.
Keep the source and continue delivery only after verifying the result.
workflow.waitReason.ArchiveUnsafeOutput: Archive output paths failed safety checks
workflow.metadata.warning.ArchiveUnsafeO: Archive output paths failed safety checks
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveUnsafeOutpu: The archive contains unsafe paths, links or collisions, or its destination is nonempty. Processing stopped.
Inspect inputs and outputs for collisions and unsafe paths. Do not overwrite existing files or relax safety checks.
Keep sources and existing outputs; revise the plan or process manually after checking them.
workflow.waitReason.ArchiveStorageUnavai: Storage required for extraction is unavailable
workflow.metadata.warning.ArchiveStorage: Storage required for extraction is unavailable
workflow.fileRecovery.ArchiveStorageUnav: The ZIP input could not be read or the private extraction directory could not be written. No result was published.
Restore the storage connection, available space and permissions, then retry this step.
Reuse existing files and completed steps without downloading or transferring again.
workflow.waitReason.DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED: An extraction dependency is not ready
workflow.metadata.warning.DEPENDENCY_REQ: An extraction dependency is not ready
workflow.fileRecovery.DEPENDENCY_REQUIRE: A dependency required by this processing step is missing or does not match the selected runtime.
Install or repair the required component in dependency management, then retry this step. Explicit ZIP password encoding requires pyzipper.
Keep the saved plan and files without changing the password, downloading or transferring again.
